title: NICE Chronic Kidney Disease Guideline 2021
content: Adults with chronic kidney disease, diabetes, and albuminuria are commonly managed with renin-angiotensin system blockade, especially ACE inhibitors or ARBs, alongside blood pressure control and risk-factor management.

title: ADA Blood Pressure Targets Update 2024
content: For diabetes with hypertension, individualized blood pressure targets and kidney-protective antihypertensive agents should be considered. ACE inhibitors or ARBs are frequently preferred when albuminuria is present.

title: Consensus Statement on Benign Thyroid Enlargement 2022
content: Evaluation of benign thyroid enlargement should consider compressive symptoms, thyroid function, and ultrasound findings. Surgical referral is mainly considered when symptoms or structural risks are present.

title: Clinical Knowledge Base for Diabetes Screening 2023
content: Diabetes complication screening commonly includes blood pressure assessment, urine albumin testing, retinal evaluation, and kidney function monitoring. Frequency may depend on duration and risk profile.

title: Lipid Management Guideline 2023
content: Lipid management commonly emphasizes LDL cholesterol lowering according to overall cardiovascular risk. Long-term treatment should integrate lifestyle management and risk stratification.

title: Primary Care Review of Hyperlipidemia 2022
content: Hyperlipidemia management in primary care often combines dietary intervention, statin-based treatment, and ongoing cardiovascular risk assessment.

title: Secondary Prevention Guideline for Coronary Artery Disease 2023
content: Secondary prevention for coronary artery disease should combine pharmacologic therapy, blood pressure and lipid control, smoking cessation, and long-term risk management.

title: Review on Secondary Prevention After Coronary Events 2022
content: Long-term prevention after coronary events requires comprehensive cardiovascular risk-factor control, medication adherence, and structured follow-up.

title: Heart Failure Guideline 2023
content: Heart failure management should assess symptoms, cardiac function, volume status, guideline-directed medical therapy, and long-term decompensation risk.

title: Review of Heart Failure Long-Term Management 2022
content: Long-term heart failure care focuses on symptom monitoring, medication adherence, fluid management, and readmission prevention.

title: Atrial Fibrillation Guideline 2023
content: Atrial fibrillation management commonly integrates stroke risk assessment, rhythm or rate strategy selection, and long-term anticoagulation considerations.

title: Review on Atrial Fibrillation Follow-Up 2022
content: Atrial fibrillation follow-up often focuses on symptom burden, recurrence risk, heart rate control, and anticoagulation adherence.

title: Stroke Secondary Prevention Guideline 2023
content: Stroke secondary prevention should address blood pressure control, lipid management, recurrence risk reduction, and rehabilitation planning.

title: Review of Post-Stroke Long-Term Care 2022
content: Long-term management after stroke commonly includes rehabilitation, vascular risk-factor control, and functional follow-up.

title: COPD Stable Management Guideline 2024
content: Stable COPD management should assess symptom burden, exacerbation history, inhaler adherence, and future exacerbation risk to guide maintenance therapy.

title: Primary Care Review of Stable COPD 2022
content: Management of stable COPD in primary care commonly focuses on symptom control, inhaled therapy optimization, smoking cessation, and exacerbation prevention.

title: Asthma Long-Term Control Guideline 2024
content: Long-term asthma control should consider symptom frequency, nighttime symptoms, exacerbation history, inhaled therapy adherence, and trigger management.

title: Review of Asthma Control Strategies 2022
content: Asthma management commonly requires regular follow-up, stepwise inhaled therapy adjustment, trigger avoidance, and patient education.

title: Community Acquired Pneumonia Guideline 2023
content: Community acquired pneumonia management should begin with severity assessment, prompt anti-infective treatment, and ongoing monitoring for complications.

title: Review on Community Acquired Pneumonia 2022
content: Evaluation of community acquired pneumonia typically includes symptom assessment, vital signs, imaging, and estimation of disease severity.

title: Tuberculosis Management Guideline 2023
content: Tuberculosis care commonly includes microbiologic diagnosis, infection control, treatment adherence monitoring, and long-term follow-up.

title: Review of Pulmonary Tuberculosis Follow-Up 2022
content: Tuberculosis follow-up focuses on symptom relief, treatment adherence, infection risk reduction, and monitoring for recurrence.

title: Iron Deficiency Anemia Guideline 2023
content: Iron deficiency anemia management should clarify the underlying cause, assess iron status, and monitor hematologic recovery during treatment.

title: Review of Iron Deficiency Evaluation 2022
content: Evaluation of iron deficiency anemia often includes hemoglobin, ferritin, and assessment of potential chronic blood loss or nutritional deficiency.

title: Osteoporosis Guideline 2023
content: Osteoporosis management usually includes fracture risk assessment, calcium and vitamin D considerations, fall prevention, and long-term bone health monitoring.

title: Review of Osteoporosis Prevention 2022
content: Osteoporosis prevention and long-term management focus on fracture risk reduction, bone density monitoring, and lifestyle support.

title: Gout Management Guideline 2023
content: Gout management generally includes urate control, flare prevention, risk-factor modification, and long-term recurrence assessment.

title: Review of Gout Care 2022
content: Long-term gout care often focuses on serum urate control, flare history, diet counseling, and joint symptom follow-up.

title: Rheumatoid Arthritis Guideline 2023
content: Rheumatoid arthritis management commonly emphasizes early treatment, inflammation control, joint function preservation, and long-term monitoring.

title: Review of Rheumatoid Arthritis Follow-Up 2022
content: Rheumatoid arthritis follow-up focuses on symptom activity, joint function, treatment response, and adverse-effect monitoring.

title: Osteoarthritis Guideline 2023
content: Osteoarthritis management generally includes pain control, function preservation, exercise support, and individualized symptom monitoring.

title: Review of Osteoarthritis Primary Care Management 2022
content: Primary care management of osteoarthritis often focuses on pain burden, mobility, lifestyle modification, and conservative therapy response.

title: GERD Guideline 2023
content: Gastroesophageal reflux disease care commonly includes symptom assessment, lifestyle modification, and treatment based on symptom pattern and alarm features.

title: Review of GERD Management 2022
content: GERD management often emphasizes reflux symptom control, trigger avoidance, lifestyle adjustment, and follow-up of persistent symptoms.

title: Peptic Ulcer Guideline 2023
content: Peptic ulcer management includes symptom evaluation, bleeding risk assessment, and appropriate treatment with attention to recurrence prevention.

title: Review of Peptic Ulcer Follow-Up 2022
content: Ulcer follow-up usually focuses on symptom improvement, complication warning signs, and recurrence risk management.

title: Acute Gastroenteritis Guideline 2023
content: Acute gastroenteritis care generally emphasizes dehydration risk evaluation, symptom monitoring, and supportive management.

title: Review of Acute Gastroenteritis in Primary Care 2022
content: Primary care evaluation of acute gastroenteritis often focuses on dehydration, symptom duration, infection clues, and warning signs.

title: Fatty Liver Disease Guideline 2023
content: Fatty liver management commonly includes metabolic risk evaluation, lifestyle intervention, and long-term liver function monitoring.

title: Review of Fatty Liver Primary Care Management 2022
content: Primary care management of fatty liver often focuses on weight reduction, metabolic syndrome screening, and follow-up liver assessment.

title: Chronic Hepatitis B Guideline 2023
content: Chronic hepatitis B management commonly includes liver function monitoring, viral activity assessment, and long-term risk stratification.

title: Review of Chronic Hepatitis B Follow-Up 2022
content: Follow-up of chronic hepatitis B often focuses on liver enzymes, disease activity, treatment indications, and long-term liver risk.

title: Urinary Tract Infection Guideline 2023
content: Urinary tract infection evaluation includes symptom assessment, recurrence risk review, and treatment planning according to clinical presentation.

title: Review of Urinary Tract Infection Care 2022
content: Urinary tract infection follow-up often focuses on symptom resolution, recurrence prevention, and recognition of warning signs.

title: Benign Prostatic Hyperplasia Guideline 2023
content: Benign prostatic hyperplasia management often includes urinary symptom assessment, quality-of-life evaluation, and individualized follow-up.

title: Review of Benign Prostatic Hyperplasia Management 2022
content: BPH follow-up usually focuses on lower urinary tract symptoms, symptom progression, and treatment response.

title: Kidney Stone Guideline 2023
content: Kidney stone care commonly includes pain assessment, recurrence risk evaluation, hydration advice, and follow-up planning.

title: Review of Kidney Stone Recurrence Prevention 2022
content: Stone recurrence prevention often focuses on hydration, metabolic risk review, and symptom monitoring.

title: Depression Guideline 2023
content: Depression management commonly includes symptom severity assessment, suicide risk review, structured follow-up, and treatment adherence monitoring.

title: Review of Depression Long-Term Care 2022
content: Long-term depression care often focuses on mood symptoms, relapse risk, psychosocial support, and treatment response.

title: Anxiety Disorder Guideline 2023
content: Anxiety disorder management often includes symptom assessment, functional impact review, follow-up of treatment response, and patient education.

title: Review of Anxiety Disorder Care 2022
content: Anxiety care commonly emphasizes long-term symptom monitoring, trigger management, and functional recovery.

title: Insomnia Guideline 2023
content: Insomnia management usually includes sleep history review, sleep hygiene support, and follow-up of daytime functional impact.

title: Review of Insomnia Management 2022
content: Long-term insomnia care often focuses on sleep routines, symptom persistence, and behavioral management strategies.

title: Migraine Guideline 2023
content: Migraine care commonly includes trigger review, attack burden evaluation, recurrence follow-up, and individualized symptom management.

title: Review of Migraine Long-Term Management 2022
content: Migraine follow-up often focuses on attack frequency, trigger recognition, and treatment response over time.

title: Eczema Guideline 2023
content: Eczema management commonly includes skin barrier care, itch assessment, trigger avoidance, and long-term symptom follow-up.

title: Review of Eczema Follow-Up 2022
content: Follow-up of eczema often focuses on itch burden, flare frequency, and skin-care adherence.

title: Urticaria Guideline 2023
content: Urticaria management generally includes trigger review, symptom burden evaluation, and follow-up of treatment response.

title: Review of Urticaria Care 2022
content: Urticaria follow-up often focuses on symptom recurrence, potential triggers, and quality-of-life impact.

title: Acne Guideline 2023
content: Acne care commonly includes lesion severity assessment, skin-care support, and follow-up of treatment response.

title: Review of Acne Long-Term Management 2022
content: Acne follow-up often focuses on symptom improvement, recurrence tendency, and adherence to skin-care routines.

title: Obesity Management Guideline 2023
content: Obesity management commonly includes weight reduction planning, metabolic risk assessment, lifestyle intervention, and long-term follow-up.

title: Review of Obesity Long-Term Care 2022
content: Long-term obesity care often focuses on sustained lifestyle change, weight trend monitoring, and complication risk reduction.
